text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"……The defeated have no need for rhetoric. 
Eloquence here is nothing short of 
arrogance."

text_block_list.text:

moment my blazing soul intoxicates the 
entire crowd."

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet

conclusion lies just ahead.

text_block_list.text:
